#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

    for (int _ = 0; _ < T; ++_) {
        int total_points, multiplier;
        cin >> total_points >> multiplier;

        vector<long long> k_list(total_points);
        for (int x = 0; x < total_points; ++x) {
            k_list[x] = (long long)multiplier * x % total_points;
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            long long result = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
                result = (result * total_points) % MOD_CONST;
            }
            cout << result << "\n";
            continue;
        } else if (multiplier == 1) {
            long long result = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
                result = (result * total_points) % MOD_CONST;
            }
            cout << result << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<int> visited(total_points, 0);
        vector<int> cycle_counts(total_points, 0);
        long long answer = 1;

        for (int start = 0; start < total_points; ++start) {
            if (visited[start]) continue;
            int length = 1;
            int current = start;
            visited[current] = 1;
            while (!visited[k_list[current]]) {
                current = k_list[current];
                visited[current] = 1;
                ++length;
            }
            cycle_counts[length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 2; size < total_points; ++size) {
            if (cycle_counts[size]) {
                long long total_size = (long long)size * cycle_counts[size] + 1;
                long long power_result = 1;
                long long base = total_size % MOD_CONST;
                long long exp = cycle_counts[size];
                long long base_pow = base;
                while (exp > 0) {
                    if (exp & 1) {
                        power_result = (power_result * base_pow) % MOD_CONST;
                    }
                    base_pow = (base_pow * base_pow) % MOD_CONST;
                    exp >>= 1;
                }
                answer = (answer * power_result) % MOD_CONST;
            }
        }

        cout << answer << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
